subject: Unusual Sign-In Attempt • Verify
body: We detected a sign-in attempt from a new device. If this was not you, secure your account immediately.
explanation: Legit security alert, uses correct domain and no suspicious links.

subject: Your Refund is Ready
body: A refund of ₹1,999 is waiting for you. Click the secure link to receive the money.
explanation: Fake Paytm support domain, refund scam pattern.

subject: Did you just sign in?
body: A new login was detected from Chrome Windows. Check activity if this wasn't you.
explanation: Actual Google security emails look similar.

subject: Payment Verification Required
body: Your last order payment could not be verified. Please confirm your details to continue.
explanation: Fake domain 'secure-flipkart.com', not owned by Flipkart.

subject: KYC Document Re-Verification
body: Your KYC has expired. Upload your PAN/Aadhaar within 24 hours to avoid service blockage.
explanation: Banks never use alternate domains like icicibank-online.com.

subject: New Device Logged In
body: A login from India was detected. If this was you, ignore this email.

subject: Mailbox Storage Almost Full
body: Your mailbox is at 98%. Increase space to avoid message loss.

subject: UPI Auto-Debit Failed
body: Your UPI auto-debit has failed. Re-authenticate using the secure link.
explanation: UPI does not send emails from random foreign-looking domains.
